title: LinkedIn Similar Companies | Lookalikes
description: Find similar LinkedIn companies from one company URL. Each lookalike includes the name, short description, location, and LinkedIn URL. Useful for account lists and ABM. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000 source companies.

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: A url column. One URL per row is also accepted.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs
maxUrls.description: Cost-control cap. Maximum 50,000. A list over 200 continues if the run stops.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many URLs to look up at the same time.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse this ID to skip URLs that already succeeded.

freshStart.title: Look up finished URLs again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and look up the whole list again.
